Marie Curie Postdoctoral Research Fellowship 2026

The Postdoctoral Fellowship program supports researchers holding a PhD who wish to acquire new skills through advanced training and international mobility.

Fellowship Benefits & Allowances

Category Monthly Gross Amount Eligibility Terms
Living Allowance €5,080 All selected fellows
Mobility Allowance €600 All fellows relocated internationally
Family Allowance €660 Fellows with family obligations

Eligibility Conditions

  • Must hold a doctoral degree (PhD) by the call deadline of 11 September 2026.
  • Maximum of 8 years full-time equivalent research experience after PhD.
  • Compliance with mobility rule: cannot have resided in the host country for more than 12 months in the past 3 years.
